newsitem.title: UK: Dixons chairman sells shares at 520p.
newsitem.headline: Dixons chairman sells shares at 520p.

text.p: Dixons Group Plc said on Friday its chairman, Sir Stanley Kalms, exercised a share option and sold some 102,000 ordinary shares at 520p each.
The option granted in 1987 at 306p per share, was due to expire on February 2, the company said in a statement.
Simultaneously, a total of 1.0 million ordinary shares owned beneficially by Kalms and his wife were sold at 520p per share.
His beneficial and family interests in the firm's ordinary shares amounted to 2.12 million shares after the transactions, Dixons said.

Dixons shares rose 9.5p to close at 517, boosted by hopes that enthusiasm over digital television in Britain would mean a surge in television and equipment sales for the electronic retailer, dealers said.
